active.title: USB and Drive copies are encrypted
active.descriptionOnServer: Every archive copied to the USB drive or Google Drive is encrypted and unreadable without the private key. The key is kept on this server: restores from this app use it automatically.
active.descriptionOffServer: Every archive copied to the USB drive or Google Drive is encrypted. The private key is no longer on this server: restore will ask you for it.
active.remove: Remove the key from this server
active.removeConfirm: Remove the private key from this server? Restoring USB/Drive copies will then require pasting it. Without your own copy, those backups would be permanently unreadable.

pending.title: Keep a copy of your private encryption key
pending.description: USB and Drive copies are now encrypted. The private key stays on this server for restores, but if the server is lost or destroyed it goes with it: keep a copy elsewhere.
pending.warning: Store it in a password manager or print it, never on the USB drive or on Drive: that would defeat the encryption.
pending.savedCheckbox: I have saved this key somewhere safe, outside this server.

prompt.title: Encrypted archive
prompt.description: "{{fileName}}" is encrypted. Paste the backup private key to decrypt and restore it.
prompt.wrongKey: This key does not match this archive.
prompt.invalidFormat: Invalid key format: it must start with "pwa-admin-key-v1:".
